stage: Single bounded supervised repair of interruption behavior; paired A/B

memory.contract: Only past/current completed actual force XYZ FIFO and original frozen-normalized actor deployment inputs. No alpha/teacher state, event counter, anchor, active, global time, onset, direction label, previous_z or future reference. FIFO initialized with zeros, no padding mask or length feature.

network.normalization: Training-only per-feature center/std with std floor0.1, shared A/B; force divided by5N before this transform

initialization.contract: Both A and B warm start from identical old A parameters AND normalization buffers; old B preserved only for paired historical regression. No separate starts, normalization refit or teacher-state features.

optimization.sampling: 50% four old normal/negative conditions equally;50% two old gaps equally; within each gap half teacher, quarter A0-visited, quarter B0-visited; each interruption episode equally sampled across pre-gap active, gap, reconnect1s, rest. Exactly shared sampled indices for A/B.
optimization.B: Original 29D q_PD MSE divided by (0.1rad)^2 through frozen actor
optimization.rationale: One conservative warm-start repair at3e-4 to retain prior mapping; no schedules, early stop, extra fit, best selection or post-test optimization.

final_checkpoints.selection: fixed update2000 for both, regardless of development/final results

physical.partner: Identical original +X geometry.delta_x_m18.6819cm path, aligned once from existing unforced standing wrist at5.4. Anchor continues its original smoothstep during both disconnects; no reset, pause, chasing wrist or modified target.
physical.disconnect: Harness toggles original Tether cfg.enabled BEFORE each actual physics application, using integer200Hz ticks; original measure/apply computes and applies zero wrench. Sensor sees that real force after original causal delay. Student and gate never receive connection flag, time, onset or anchor.
physical.reconnect: Re-enable original capped spring-damper at same ongoing world anchor; no new force smoothing, stiffness, model or PD changes. This is an ideal detach/regrasp external task perturbation, not fake zero sensor input.

qualification.criteria_rationale: 0.05 alpha is5% of the fixed skill path (~3.35deg latent angle), larger than prior full-fit alpha RMS and comparable to prior maximum fit error. Long20% decay is a loose directional exit check, not exact imitation. Same-state shadow teacher uses student's real force history; no labels enter actuation.
qualification.physical: No original safety boundary, falls, support loss or actual joint-limit violation; root speed release+2s<=0.02m/s. Report all action/torque jumps and saturation, no new smoother.
qualification.task: For each Student and condition report active-only XYZ error/force and post-reconnect gain versus paired standing and teacher. Qualification additionally requires post-reconnect3D error below standing. Prior30%/5% criteria reported as historical reference, not silently assumed to apply to changed interruption task.
qualification.decision: No expansion recommendation unless both timing/retention and physical task criteria hold. A failed criterion is retained; do not tune thresholds or checkpoints.

old_regression.material_regression: Per matched old checkpoint report error/force/qPD/alpha/recovery; >5% worsening in normal tracking or force RMS is flagged, not averaged away. Old5.4/4.6 now regression, never called new final.

post_test: Only saved-record diagnosis, no new policy updates or rollout collection for repair. Final tested once; source/implementation bugs recorded and corrected without result-dependent checkpoint selection.
stop: Original physics safety boundaries or resource limits stop stage; no CPU model fallback; no shared code/weights/gate modifications; no push/Bridge/PPO
original_assets: All teacher traces/checkpoints are immutable. New output root issue21-alpha-repair-20261031A.
